notes: Every entry below was verified on 2026-09-25 against:
1. The DexScreener pair the operator selected (base token address, liquidity, 24h volume)
2. A direct eth_call to BNB Smart Chain for name(), symbol(), decimals() and totalSupply()
3. getBytecode() on the token address, to see what kind of contract it actually is
The roster is exactly the six assets chosen for the single machine. Identity is the
address in every lookup — there is deliberately no resolve-by-ticker path, because two
contracts can claim the same symbol and only one of them is the asset that was meant.
Project logos remain the trademarks of their projects and are used only to identify
which token a reward consists of. See data/image-credits.json.
